import json, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
import stress6
req = stress6.build()
data = json.dumps(req).encode()
for target, label in ((8388608, 'exactly-at-limit'), (8388609, 'one-over'), (8389000, 'over')):
    pad = target - len(data)
    if pad < 0:
        print(label, 'base too big', len(data)); continue
    blob = data + b' ' * pad
    t0=time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '/app/submission/main.py'], input=blob, capture_output=True)
    print('%s: bytes=%d rc=%d wall=%.2f out=%r' % (label, len(blob), p.returncode, time.time()-t0, p.stdout.decode()[:60]))
# huge but valid: pad inside
EOF
